# Regenerating SpacetimeDB Bindings

**NEVER manually modify autogenerated files in `module_bindings/`.** Always use the custom generator binary instead.

When regenerating SpacetimeDB module bindings for the admin app or sender, you MUST use the local custom `spacetimedb-cli` debug binary located at:
`../SpacetimeDB/target/debug/spacetimedb-cli` (or `/home/<user>/Projekte/Source/SpacetimeDB/target/debug/spacetimedb-cli`).

Note: Because `../SpacetimeDB` is located in the sibling directory outside this workspace, commands accessing it must run with `BypassSandbox: true`.

Do NOT use the system `spacetimedb-cli` or `spacetime generate`.

### Commands

Run both commands together or individually:
```bash
../SpacetimeDB/target/debug/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=dioxus -p server -o admin/src/module_bindings/ && ../SpacetimeDB/target/debug/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=rust -p server -o sender/src/module_bindings/
```

- For the Dioxus Admin application:
```bash
../SpacetimeDB/target/debug/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=dioxus -p server -o admin/src/module_bindings/
```

- For the Rust Sender service:
```bash
../SpacetimeDB/target/debug/spacetimedb-cli generate --lang=rust -p server -o sender/src/module_bindings/
```

When prompted by the CLI regarding stale files to delete, confirm deletion.
